_about: Fixes from the build reviews (pohaku-build workflow), applied by build_words.py after the curation. glosses: card glosses rephrased so no English apostrophe sits beside an ʻokina (DESIGN §4.4). words: per-word sense changes.

glosses.hoahānau: cousin; kin of the same generation
glosses.paʻa kāhili: kāhili bearer, attendant of a chief

makaʻala.reason: ʻala on its own is 'fragrant' and 'awake' is ala (PPN *q leaves no ʻokina), so the stone cannot be glossed 'awake' without teaching a false root; left unresolved until Pukui & Elbert's Lit. settles it (DECISIONS B10).
